commit.message:
fix: Fastly KV sync scaling + NIP-05 status + write-path verification (#44)

* docs: Fastly KV cron sync scaling spec and implementation plan

Design spec and task-level implementation plan for fixing the hourly
cron that syncs D1 usernames to Fastly KV. Sequential sync of 131K+
users times out; solution: delta sync (2hr window) for steady state,
paginated admin endpoint for full backfills, both with 10x concurrency.

* feat: cron sync scaling -- delta sync, pagination, concurrent Fastly KV writes

Replace sequential full-table Fastly KV sync (timed out at 131K users)
with delta cron + paginated admin endpoint + bounded concurrency.

- syncBatch: promise pool with configurable concurrency (default 10)
- Cron handler: delta sync via updated_at index (2hr overlap window)
- Admin POST /sync/fastly: cursor-based pagination, dry_run mode
- getActiveUsernamesPaginated + countActiveUsernames queries
- Admin UI: sync button with progress bar, confirm/cancel/stop
- scripts/backfill-fastly-kv.sh: CLI for full backfill (--dry-run/--apply)
- Remove dead code: bulkSyncToFastly, getAllActiveUsernames
- Migration: idx_usernames_updated_at index
- 275 tests passing (25 new)

* fix: code review fixes -- remaining calc, response contract, defensive errors

- Fix remaining calculation: use COUNT WHERE id > cursor instead of
  subtracting cursor ID from total (was producing wrong numbers)
- Add deleted field to non-dry-run response to match spec contract
- Add total field to dry-run response for accurate UI progress bar
- Remove dead processed variable
- syncBatch: error instead of silent discard when sync item has no data
- Backfill script: clarify auth expects Keycast session cookie

* fix: backfill script cookie name (__session) and countActiveUsernames truthiness guard

* feat: NIP-05 status check, single-user re-sync, write-path verification

Completes issue #40 items 2-4:

- GET /username/:name/nip05-status compares Fastly KV with DB
- POST /username/:name/sync-to-fastly re-syncs one username with read-back
- syncAndVerifyUsername wraps sync + GET verification on all individual
  write paths (assign, revoke, claim, set-atproto). Batch/cron paths
  skip verification to avoid doubling API calls at scale.
- Admin UI: Fastly KV status indicator + re-sync button on username detail

* fix: add durable Fastly sync reconciliation

* fix: tighten Fastly queue recovery semantics

* fix: handle revoked fastly cleanup and sync reporting

---------

Co-authored-by: Liz Sweigart <127434495+NotThatKindOfDrLiz@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: rabble <evan@protest.net>
